_comment: 同じ ページの カード3。**ネクマックスが 出る 唯一の 1枚**なので 台帳を 分けた —— ほかの 台帳は negative で robots / mascots を 禁じて いる（そこへ 混ぜると ロボットが 出ない か、出ては いけない 絵に 出る）。ネクマックスの 記述は skill §3 の マスター記述を 逐語で 使う。参照は 正典・**合格ずみの バリアント build.webp**・学生の 顔（g1）・同じ ページの 1枚目（絵柄アンカー）。正典の 原画だけだと 頭が 卵形に なり、顔面が 小さく なった（2026-08-28 実発生）ので、アプリで 使って いる 絵も 渡す。
style: Style: warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, soft cel shading with gentle light, bright natural daylight, warm cream walls with sky-blue and coral accents, tidy contemporary offices and classrooms with real desks, chairs, windows, plants, mugs and laptops. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions and warm friendly faces. Every picture is a REAL PLACE seen from a natural camera angle, and the subject FILLS THE WHOLE FRAME.
nexmax: Character in the scene: "NexMax", the official robot mascot of NEXT MAKE. His anatomy must match the first two reference images EXACTLY — copy the head shape from them, do not restyle it. Head: a WIDE rounded-square helmet, clearly WIDER than it is tall, light sky-blue (#A9D6F5) with soft shading (#7FB8E8), drawn with a slightly rough warm black outline. Face-screen: a VERY LARGE white rounded-square panel that fills most of the front of the helmet, edge to edge, with a soft notch dipping at the top center. Two BIG round solid-black eyes sit low and wide apart on this white panel, with a small open smiling mouth below them showing a warm orange inside. Two thin curved black eyebrow marks sit on the blue helmet ABOVE the white panel. Ear pods: one small rounded sky-blue pod on EACH side of the helmet, left and right. Body: a small trapezoid torso in the same sky-blue, much smaller than the head, carrying the NEXT MAKE chest mark — a navy (#004F8D) double-peak "M" made of two triangular mountain shapes. Segmented ball-joint arms with round elbows and mitten hands; short segmented legs with rounded boots. Chibi proportion, about 2 heads tall, small enough to stand on the desk. Mood: friendly, curious, encouraging.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image. Screens, papers, whiteboards, books and signs are blank or show only soft abstract shapes and simple pictures. No watermark, no signature, no logo. The only mark allowed anywhere is the navy double-peak "M" on the robot's chest.
negative: Never: flat vector icon art, pictograms, infographic diagrams, symbols floating on an empty background, wide empty margins, minimalist clip-art, 3D render, photo realism, harsh gradients, readable letters or numbers, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, dark or scary tone, angry or crying faces, extra fingers or limbs. Only ONE robot in the picture and it must be NexMax exactly as described — no other robots, no other mascots, no realistic humanoid machines.

scenes.title: 3 NEXT MAKEで 何を やって みたい？（ネクマックスを 動かす）
scenes.output: Output: one square illustration, 1024x1024. Close view — the subject fills the frame edge to edge.
scenes.scene: Scene: THE STUDENT is a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with shoulder-length straight dark hair and a warm coral-orange blouse; keep her face, hair and blouse exactly the same as in the second reference image. She sits at a bright desk beside a window, smiling with concentration, one hand on the laptop keyboard. NexMax the small sky-blue robot stands on the desk right next to the laptop, connected to it by a single soft coiled cable that runs from a port on his side into the laptop. He looks up at her happily, one mitten hand raised as if he has just started moving. The laptop screen shows soft abstract blocks of coloured code with no readable characters. A green plant, a warm mug and a small screwdriver lie on the desk. Warm daylight from the window.
